recap.headline: Wemby Eats, Suggs Starves
recap.subhead: Nova Knicks went 8-2-1 on the night while Suggs to be you shot 2-for-15 into a hole.

zingers.line: Brandon Miller went 2-for-15 for 10 points and a 2-8-1 night, so your one-category lead over Nova Knicks is a rental.
Derrick White dropped 24 points and 7 assists on your bench, 41 points left there, and you're tied 5-5 with BrookynDynasty.
Naji Marshall put up 22 on 9-of-12 while you benched him, and Wemby's 52 had to cover for it.

zingers.team: Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw
zingers.line: Brook Lopez left 20 points on your bench, yet Luka's 40 and six threes keep dragging you toward a title you predicted.
Paul George shot 8-of-18 for 25 and 4 steals, and still Nolan Traore and Dillon Brooks are carrying the roster.
Power rankings call you first, but White Mambas beat you 7-3 last night and you're one assist lead from losing the week.
Scottie Barnes went 7-of-15 and your punt build lost 6-4 to Zero Fox Given, who punts points. Think about that.

night: Victor Wembanyama, Nova Knicks: 52 PTS, 24 REB, 8 BLK on 16-28 FG. A statement night, and it stole eight categories from Suggs to be you.
Brandon Miller, Suggs to be you: 10 PTS on 2-15 FG. The worst brick of the night helped bury Suggs 2-8-1.
Derrick White sat on LeParth James's bench for 24 PTS and 7 AST on 7-18 FG. That's 41 points left behind, the night's worst blunder.
Grayson Allen hit 22 PTS and 5 3PTM on 6-11 FG, and he is still on the wire. Twelve managers slept on him.
Nova Knicks won the night 8-2-1 over Suggs to be you, who lost 2-8-1. Wemby's 52 points was the entire gap.
